verdict.rationale: Apple's own materials claim a 40-core GPU with a 2x faster hardware ray-tracing engine and say games like Control 'look more compelling,' but they never state frame rates. The pack has no independent game benchmarks, and community items cover CPU Geekbench scores or Unreal Engine game-dev sluggishness, not measured gaming frame rates. Missing for 10: independent game benchmark corroboration, concrete frame-rate claims in real games, cache/boost-behavior gaming claims, any hands-on gaming evidence.
